$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFPL (AIP France, AMDT 03/26,
effective 19 FEB 2026). Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and
are not redistributed. Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the
simulator at run time; this file holds what the simulator does not know: services, circuit
rules and reporting points. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
The circuit side was read off the landing chart drawing, not from a text, and is worth a second look.
name: Lognes-Émerainville

service.atsHours: 0800 to sunset + 30 min, limited to 1900 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer)

circuit.handNote: the circuit lies north of the runways, so it is left-hand for runway 08 and right-hand for runway 26 (read off the landing chart, AD 2 LFPL ATT 01)
circuit.lowHeight: only with an instructor on board, in the published direction, cleared by ATS
circuit.restrictedWeekendsAndHolidays: Saturday, Sunday and public holidays: circuits reserved for home-based aircraft or aircraft authorised by ATS

landmark.description: red and white checkerboard on the roof of an H-shaped building
landmark.use: overfly on base leg runway 08 or crosswind runway 26

reportingPoints.name: E
reportingPoints.location: abeam north of Château de Ferrières
reportingPoints.purpose: reporting point for arrivals from the east

arrivals.instruction: contact the tower at least 2 minutes before point E, at 1200 ft AMSL

arrivals.note: runway 08 in use: avoid arriving from the south-east, to stay clear of the initial climb

withAts.arrivalUnlessImpossible: circuit lights on and speed below 100 kt

departures.note: leaving the 08 circuit, do not interfere with the arrival path via E
reach it before half downwind where possible
do not interfere with the arrival path via E

radio.arrival: once the runway is vacated, contact Lognes Sol directly
radio.departure: at the holding point, on Sol's clearance, hold and monitor the tower frequency until Lognes Tour calls

arrivals.contactBefore: overhead the facilities or integration in the runway circuit

departures.runway26: climb in the circuit to 1500 ft before half downwind where possible
departures.afterHalfDownwind: join the aerodrome overhead for a departure on magnetic 120
